title: Boston Gas Company submits for review and approval of a Firm Transportation Agreement with Fidelity Corporate Real Estate LLC.
petitioner: Boston Gas Company d/b/a National Grid
filings: The Department APPROVES the proposed Agreement. The Department also finds that the pricing terms of the Agreement are competitively sensitive, and therefore GRANTS the Company's request for protection from public disclosure. Commissioners participating were: James Connelly, Chairman; Commissioners W. Robert Keating, Paul B. Vasington, Eugene J. Sullivan, Jr., and Deirdre K. Manning. (GC 01-12)
